reason: A chat-interface monitoring plugin that displays DeepSeek balance and OpenCode Go usage quotas, with configured manual and automatic refreshes via authenticated provider APIs.

summaries.zh: 在聊天输入框中显示 DeepSeek 余额和 OpenCode Go 用量，并支持手动及定时刷新。
summaries.en: Displays DeepSeek balance and OpenCode Go usage in the chat composer with manual and scheduled refreshes.

capabilities: Reads configured DeepSeek and OpenCode Go credentials host-side
Makes authenticated read-only requests to provider quota endpoints
Displays account balance and token-usage information in the chat composer
Stores and applies refresh interval and credential-reference settings
Performs debounced manual and interval-based automatic refreshes
